title: Kenyan Loaded Chips Masala
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Loaded Chips Masala — masala fries piled high with spiced minced beef, kachumbari, garlic mayo, cheese, and pili pili. Nairobi's most indulgent street food upgrade — completely over the top and completely irresistible.
longDesc: Loaded chips masala is the peak of Nairobi's modern street food culture — the masala fries concept taken to its absolute maximum. Piled with spiced beef, fresh kachumbari, two sauces, and melted cheese, it is a meal that demands to be eaten in company and discussed for days afterwards.
ingredients: 600g potatoes — chipped and fried with masala spices
steps: Cook minced beef with onion, garlic, curry powder, paprika, and salt until browned and dry.
Make masala fries as per KEN225.
Place hot fries in a serving bowl.
Scatter cheese over beef. Grill briefly or microwave until cheese melts.
Add kachumbari, drizzle garlic mayo and pili pili sauce.
Serve immediately — this does not wait.
chefTips: Everything must be hot when assembled — cold elements make the cheese solidify.
The kachumbari goes on after the cheese so it stays fresh.
Serve with napkins — this is gloriously messy.
commonMistakes: Too much topping — the fries must still be accessible.
cookingScience: The cheese melt over the hot beef creates a sauce-like consistency — the fat in the cheese liquefies and coats the beef and fries beneath. Adding the fresh kachumbari after the cheese preserves its cold, acidic contrast against the hot, rich toppings.
sustainabilityTips: A shared loaded portion is a more sustainable way to enjoy fries than individual portions.
culturalNote: Loaded chips masala represents Nairobi's confident, creative street food culture — taking something already beloved and piling it higher, making it richer, and making it more unapologetically indulgent.
